defaults.permitted_development: Across Yorkshire, a temporary building is not exempt simply because it will be removed later. The planning answer usually turns on how fixed it is, how long it remains, what it is used for and whether any specific temporary-use right actually applies.

rules.height_rules: There is no standard height allowance for temporary buildings. The taller and more engineered the structure looks, the harder it is to present it as a minor temporary feature rather than operational development needing permission.

rules.boundary_rules: Across Yorkshire, access, traffic, noise, overlooking, servicing and visibility at the site edge are often what turn a supposedly temporary structure into a proposal that needs fuller planning scrutiny.
rules.roof_rules: A fixed or heavily engineered roof can quickly make a temporary structure look permanent. Wind loading, rainwater handling and visual bulk all matter.
